proposals.evidence: OP Derive(Canonical) -> Derived; INV Derived != Canonical
proposals.notes: Canonical is the sole authoritative source for Derived states.

proposals.evidence: OP Commit(Canonical, Evidence) -> Canonical'; INV Mutate(Canonical) => Op == Commit
proposals.notes: Commit is the exclusive mutation operator for Canonical state.

proposals.evidence: INV Working.authoritative == false; INV Candidate.authoritative == false
OP Derive(Canonical) -> Derived; INV DER-001: dependencies(target) = {source}
proposals.notes: Derived state depends exclusively on Canonical source.
HistoryStore must strictly adhere to append-only invariants.

proposals.evidence: PRE Derive : Pure | Deterministic; INV_DEF PUR-001: pure(f: Function)
proposals.notes: Derivation operation must be pure and deterministic.

proposals.evidence: OP Commit(Canonical, Evidence) -> Canonical'; INV Evidence.causal_order == true
proposals.notes: Evidence provided to Commit must maintain causal order.
